## II. Point, Appendix III: Why the Flesh Must Totally Die. Text IV.

-> 72. <-

Now we must consider the *propagation* <note>original: "propagation"; the reproduction and continuation of the human race</note> of humanity. The human body has become earthly because the vanity from which the earth was generated has *awakened* within it and has swallowed the holy, heavenly substance into itself.

<margin>* Genesis 3:17–20</margin>
73. For the true Love-Spirit departed from humanity during the *curse* of the earth. When vanity awakened, God *cursed the earth; then, the beautiful Paradise of humanity was finished. His heavenly image of divine substance <note>original: "substantiality"; the spiritual essence that gives form to reality</note> faded and was no longer known.

74. This can be understood through a metaphor: imagine looking at LEAD that had previously been GOLD. Through the action of MERCURY, it turned itself into lead, in which the poisonous *Mercury* is now revealed—the same force that previously existed in gold in great brightness and perfection.

75. Just as there is still a possibility for *gold* to exist within the *lead*, it was not visible in the *Mercury*. The *Mercury* could not turn itself back into *gold* unless the *Artist* <note>In alchemy, the "Artist" is the alchemist; here, it refers to God as the divine transformer</note> came and totally broke the *lead* to pieces, returning it to the "first matter" from which it was created. Only then could beautiful *gold* emerge from that matter, just as it was in the beginning.

76. Or else, if the power of *Sol* <note>original: "Sol"; the Latin word for the Sun. In alchemy, the Sun represents the divine spirit or gold</note> moved within this *Mercury* of the lead—which is like *Saturn* <note>In alchemy, Saturn represents lead, darkness, and the heavy physical world</note>, yet contains the "impression," or the original foundation for *gold*—it could generate *gold* once more within its power. In that case, I would see *lead* and *gold* in ONE substance; however, the gold would not be visible, for the *lead* holds the *gold* as if it were half-swallowed and covered.

77. We should understand *Adam and Eve* in this same way. Their beautiful *golden body*, filled with divine power and substance, became a *dark, obscure lead* (to use a metaphor). When the *golden Mercury* awakened in the vanity of the poison, the *gold*—namely, the holy body—faded and vanished into the abomination. Now it was entirely earthly and must return to the earth again.

78. But the voice of God, which called to them again, united <note>original: "espoused"</note> itself with the promise of the "Serpent Crusher" <note>A reference to the prophecy in Genesis 3:15, traditionally interpreted by Christians as the coming of Christ to defeat evil</note> within *Venus's Matrix* <note>original: "Matrix"; the womb or creative source. "Venus" here refers to the spiritual quality of love and light</note>. This occurred in the Second Principle <note>The realm of Light and Divine Love</note>, in that part of the heavenly substance where the Word of the divine sound had previously been revealed. But when the soul’s desire turned away from it, that substance had faded and vanished within itself.

79. Thus, in this union within the *lead*, *gold* and *lead* existed together, though the *gold* was not revealed until God’s *Mercury* (in the Word of Promise) manifested itself in the *lead*—that is, in the *flesh*. Then, the *lead* in Christ's humanity was changed back into *gold*. ### IV.T. Out of what the true life in soul & spirit existeth III. A.P. II

94. Her seed is, in its outward aspect, totally *drossy* <note>original: "Cagastrish"; a term derived from Paracelsus referring to corrupt, earthly, or diseased matter</note>; but if she is holy, then in the inward it follows the faded *Image* and is *astral* <note>original: "Iliastrish"; referring to the "Iliaster," the vital or spiritual force of the stars and nature</note>. That is, it is half-*paradisiacal*; for it carries the "Rose Garden" in which God became man. According to the second principle, it carries the house of PARADISE; but in the outward principle, it carries the child of the existing abomination arising from Adam's lust; and in the third principle—namely, in earthliness—it carries the dying, which is death and earthliness.

95. The man carries in his seed, in the first principle, the fire-world—namely, the Father's property, out of which the Father manifests his Son, his love, and *Venus's womb* <note>original: "Venus'es Matrix"; here used to represent the feminine principle of desire and love within the spiritual structure</note>. This is the property of the second principle in him, but it is not manifested in his seed except as a glimmering tinder or mother, so far as he is holy. And in the third principle, he carries in the *sulphur* and *mercury* <note>original: "Sulphur and Mercury"; in Boehme’s alchemy, Sulphur represents the "soul" or combustible desire, and Mercury represents the "spirit" or the active, communicative force</note> of his seed the awakened anger of God, in which the abomination against God existed and became manifested in *Venus's womb*—that is, in the woman’s property.

96. These properties are brought into ONE through the joining of the seeds of man and woman. There, the two *tinctures* <note>original: "Tinctures"; spiritual life-forces or qualities</note> receive one another in great joy, as is found by experience: when the seed goes forth, the *tincture* lifts itself up in joy, which moves the man's life like a joyful vision—a matter well understood by those who are "ours" <note>Boehme's way of referring to fellow initiates or "lovers of mysteries"</note>.

97. And the two *tinctures* marry themselves thus instantly into one within the *sulphur* of the seed; they awaken the *mercury*—namely, the master-worker of life—so that he labors in the seed and awakens the forms of life in the *sulphur*.

98. And if the *mercury* is not powerful enough, then it draws the mother’s *biological substance* <note>original: "Menstruum"; refers here to the physical matter or blood provided by the mother to form and nourish the fetus</note> to itself and brings it into the seed of the union. Then it makes the seed in that *substance* become FLESH. In this flesh, there is still a material poison and the great abomination against holiness and purity. It is sufficiently understood by all "lovers of mysteries" what kind of poison lies in that *substance*, which destroys and poisons any tender plant of the earth, as is undeniable.

99. Now, in this *substance* and poison, the seed has become flesh; and both *tinctures* are within it and receive their nourishment from its substance. Out of THAT, the true life in soul and spirit exists.

<margin>* E. S.</margin> 100. Where now, in this, is the total holiness without blemish according to this *author? Let him show it to me.

### Jacob Boehme's Answer
#### To this Explanation of this Third Point of the Fourth Text.

### I.

1. <margin>* E. S.</margin> <note>original: "E. S."; likely referring to Esaias Stiefel, a contemporary critic whose views Boehme is refuting.</note> **This author** mentions the **Triune God** and the **Man CHRIST**, and concerning the *Divine Woman* or *wife* <note>A mystical reference to Divine Wisdom or the "Sophia."</note>; and he signifies that not **only** *all things* were created through and for that **Triune Man CHRIST**, but *also after the Fall*, all things were **perfectly delivered** by his holy **becoming human** <note>original: "Becoming Man"</note> or *Incarnation*, and his precious *Inward Passion*, **Dying**, **Resurrection**, and **Ascension** into **Heaven**, and his *perfect* merit.

2. All of this requires a very *different* explanation. For if I say **CHRIST** is the **Triune God**, then I am speaking of no **man** or **creature**; for the **Holy Trinity** is neither **man** nor **woman**, much less a **creature**.

3. He has only manifested himself through and **IN** **humanity**, and made himself visible in a **human image**. But the visible, palpable **substance** of the **flesh** is not the **Triune Deity**. Rather, the *Spirit* in the power of the **flesh**—the **divine Spirit** in the **spiritual**, the *uncreated* <note>original: "uncreaturely"</note> **IN** the **creaturely**—is **GOD**.

4. **CHRIST**, so far as he is called the **Triune God** according to the **Eternal Word**, in the **Name JEHOVAH** or **JESUS**, and so far as concerns the *immeasurable* **God**, is no **man** or **creature**, but the *fullness* of all things *dwelling* in himself.

5. <margin>* Christ of God. <note>original: "Χριστὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ"</note></margin> But according to the *Name CHRIST*, the **Deity** is visible; and this * **CHRIST**, namely **the** *Anointed* **of God**, penetrates only, or presses upon, humanity, **NOT** upon **ALL creatures**. He unites himself to **NO creature** *except man*. Also, through his **Incarnation**, **suffering**, **dying**, and **resurrection**, he has delivered **NO creature** except **MAN**.

6. <margin>† NOTE: The Heavenly Creatures need NO CHRIST, and the Hellish Creatures have NO CHRIST.</margin> With the **Name CHRIST**, he has become manifest **only** in **humanity**, not in **earthly** or **heavenly creatures**. † The **earthly** and **heavenly creatures** need **NO Christ**, and the **hellish have NONE.** <note>Boehme argues that Christ is the mediator specifically for fallen humanity; heavenly beings are already in union with God, and hellish beings are entirely separated from Him.</note>

<vocab>Jacob Behme, Triune God, Christ, Incarnation, Deity, Humanity, Heavenly Creatures, Hellish Creatures, JEHOVA, JESUS</vocab>

<summary>Jacob Boehme clarifies that while Christ is the Triune God, the divine essence is distinct from human flesh, and Christ's redemptive work is uniquely for humanity rather than for heavenly or hellish beings.</summary>

<header>IV. T. The Father greater than the Man Christ. III. A. P. III.</header>

7. This is the **Christ** through whom God, who dwells in him and has manifested himself with the **Christ**, will judge all things and separate the good from the evil. He is not manifested in other creatures in a way that he would deliver them to eternity and dwell in them as a creature <note>original: "dwell Creaturely"</note> as he dwells in **MAN**. All other creatures of this world, except man, return again to that from which they originated in the beginning.

8. When I speak of the man **CHRIST**, and what kind of threefold God and man he is, I distinguish the **human** nature <note>original: "humane Creature"</note> which he has **received** from us human beings, and differentiate it from the Triune **Deity**—the manifested substance from the power and omnipotence.

<margin>* NOTE</margin>

9. This is not to say that he is **divided**, but that the Spirit of God is **higher** than the substance which he generates in his **desire**, in his exhaled sound <note>Boehme often uses "sound" or "breath" to describe the creative word of God.</note>. For according to **our substance**, **CHRIST** calls himself the Son of Man and says: *The Father is greater than I.* <note>original: "the Father is greater than HEE." A reference to John 14:28.</note>

10. According to his humanity, he has a **given power**, and according to his deity, he is the **Giver himself**. The "Man" is our humanity, and **Christ** is the Anointed One of God, whom God has manifested out of the name **JEHOVAH** or **JESUS**, out of the depths of wisdom, out of the **center** of God, and out of the great love. He has given this to the human nature as a light and eternal seed.

11. It is not that this lovely, blessed, sweet love of Christ *is* the man, but rather it is the holy **sunshine** in the great flame of love within the man. For when I see a holy Christian man walking or standing, I do not say, "There goes or stands Christ"; rather, I say, "There goes or stands a Christian man in whom the Sun, **CHRIST**, shines."

12. The person of **Adam** is not the **Christ**; rather, the person of the power of God who dwells in the man **Adam** according to the heavenly part—**that is Christ**.

13. Just as the sun shines in the whole outward world and **empowers** everything and makes it fruitful, yet the world is not the sun; so also **CHRIST** shines as a revealed or manifested sun out of **JEHOVAH** or **JESUS** in the created humanity of **Christ**.

14. The name "Christ" is the revealed or manifested sun from the eternal name **JEHOVAH** or **JESUS**. **JEHOVAH** is the eternal divine **SUN**, in which this great love-sun, **CHRIST**—like a heart in the center of the Holy Trinity—has been hidden from all creatures. Yet, through the second movement <note>original: "moving"; referring to the second person of the Trinity.</note> of the Deity, it has become manifested as a holy, sweet love-sun.

15. I must not say that in the person of **CHRIST**—namely, in the man according to his humanity, according to that part which he has from us human beings, from our body and soul—that is, attached to the Deity, attached to the divine substantiality or heavenly corporeity he has taken on...

Instead, it was *Adam* <note>meaning the old, sinful human nature</note> dying in Christ’s death, so that Christ’s Spirit might live in the soul and the holy man. When Christ is born within a person, then the "man of sin" should continually die until the outer body finally passes away and sin ceases *entirely*.

and then it comes not solely and only from the Son of Mary.

Abel and all the *martyrs* died as to their own bodies; for the sake of the Covenant, which opened itself in them, they were slain and died as to their sinful Adamical body <note>original: "Adamicall Body"; refers to the fallen human nature inherited from Adam</note>, and not as to the holy body. That which dies is *only* the body of Christ’s members according to the human creature, and not according to the Spirit of Christ.

31. The Spirit of Christ has therefore manifested itself in humanity and slain Death in his assumed body so that the gates of life in us should be opened. 32. My dying is *Christ’s resurrection* in ME; for I die away from the sinful self-hood or *nothingness* <note>original: "Nothingneſſe"; here meaning the temporary, empty nature of the ego apart from God</note>, and live for the sake of resignation <note>original: "Reſignation"; Boehme's specific term for the total yielding or surrender of the self-will to God</note> in the Spirit of Christ.

33. Therefore, what * this author writes is a void and groundless thing: that the man Christ, the innocent Lamb of God, God himself, was slain in all the saints and faithful from the beginning of the world according to the testimony of the Scripture.

34. The Triune God is *not slain in his saints from the beginning of the world*. The Scripture does not say so; rather, the *faithful men* were slain for Christ’s sake, and NOT the *Triune Christ IN them*.

35. Man in his self-hood and "I-hood" <note>original: "I-hood"; the self-centered ego</note> is not Christ himself, but Christ *dwells* in him. He is the shining luster of his holy life, as he himself says in John 8:12: *I am the light of the world*. He speaks this according to the name CHRIST out of JESUS, and not according to our humanity, which died on the *cross*.

<header>IV. T. What Body became a curse on the Cross. IV. A. P. IV.</header>

## Here follows My Answer upon the Fourth Point of the Fourth Text.

->1.<-

I would even leave this fourth point unexplained if it had been produced by the author with a right understanding. But he jumbles everything together and sticks his erroneous meaning into it, making it much more of a *confusion* than a right explanation. However, seeing as I have explained its contents *above* in almost every particular, I will therefore only explain the *chief* matters and extract the erroneous opinions out of his confusion for the sake of the reader.

<margin>E. S. <note>Refers to Esaiah Stiefell, the author being critiqued.</note></margin>

8. Also, if CHRIST—namely, the Word of God—had taken upon himself a totally holy and perfect body and soul while on Earth, both inwardly and outwardly, *how* would he have broken the power of death? 9. This is the kind of understanding this view provides if we say Mary was totally perfect in the faith—in flesh and blood, in body and soul—and totally united with the holy, divine substance.

72. If it were certainly true—and if the *Old Patriarchs* did not also carry the *Image of Sin* upon them—if he could show they had been *totally Holy*, then for the *Old Patriarchs* there would have been *NO Transformation* <note>original: "Transmutation"; a change in form or nature, specifically referring here to the resurrection and glorification of the body</note> of *their Bodies*; and likewise *NOT* for the *Apostles*, according to their *outward Flesh*.

### IV. P: A: III. We should continually kill our vanity and sin. T. IV.

<margin>+ NOTE</margin>
133. Our whole life should be a continual **repentance**, for it is even a continual **sinning**. And though indeed the **noble lily branch**—newly generated or born in **Christ's** Spirit—does not sin, yet the **earthly man** in soul and body sins and **continually** wills to break or destroy the noble **rosebud** again and completely hide it.

134. The more **divine oil** is introduced into the noble **rosebud** out of the **wounds** and **death** of **Christ**, the fresher and fairer it grows, and the more beautifully it **blossoms**.

135. Here is the field where the fruit grows; let no one be persuaded to such sluggishness, nor lie on such a soft bed as to think he **is** fully grown and **quite** or fully **blossomed**. Oh, no, no, by no means.

136. But **continually without ceasing** draw divine essence to yourself in the greatest humility, from and out of God’s love, just as a **bee** draws **honey** out of the fair blossoms or flowers. For as soon as **man** is secure or careless and thinks he is **holy honey**, then the Devil brings poison to him in his vanity, which his own self-will—in its own self-lust or longing—**sucks** into itself.

137. The **man** that would gladly <note>original: "fain"</note> grow and bear fruit in God's kingdom cannot do better than to suck all his power and virtue—which he will use for the growing or springing of his life—through **Christ's** blood and death. He should continually cast his vanity to the ground before the truth and clarity <note>original: "Clarity," meaning spiritual brightness or radiance</note> of God, and continually live as if he were **dying**, where he mightily presses on to the **death** of **sin**.

<margin>* NOTE</margin>
138. **No city** or place of **rest** belongs to **sin** and vanity; for as soon as sin **rests**, **then** the desire for vain lust or **pleasure** grows. The fair rosebud grows out of this dying, which is then carried in **God's** hand to the joy and rejoicing of the **Deity**.

# IV.T. *We should live in continual Repentance.* III.A.P.IV.

...or acknowledged as a *curse* of the world. Yes, we would fix the man of vanity onto the *cross* of Christ, so that the poor sinner might see him.

155. And we would not so boldly play with *Christ’s purple mantle* <note>original: "Christs Purple Mantle" — Referring to the robe placed on Jesus during his passion, symbolizing both his suffering and the grace that covers the sins of the repentant.</note> under that *cover*—which belongs to the poor *converted sinner* who lives in *continual repentance*, and especially to the sinner who is captivated and held tightly by the devil, against whom the devil would shut the *door of* grace.

156. Such a person should wrap themselves in it; and the person who is strong in *faith and knowledge* should cast the mantle of Christ, his Chief *Shepherd*, around himself. As a *lamb* in patience, he should go among the *flock*. The mantle that Christ continually casts upon him, he should cast upon *his brothers and fellow members*.

157. And help to fight and wrestle in them, through prayer, teaching, and life, so that *God’s will be done in* us, and *his kingdom come in and to* us. Then we may bear fruit as one single tree in all its sprouts, sprigs, and branches, and show our blossoms or flowers before God and his angels, so that we also may enjoy the *fruit* eternally. Amen.

Jacob Boehme's Preface of the Apology to Gregory Richter. Apology IV.

# THE PREFACE
## To the Reader who loves God.

->I.<-

1. Christ says to Pilate: *My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, my servants would fight for it* (John 18:36). And to his disciples he says, *Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves* (Matthew 10:16). This signifies that wherever Christ becomes manifest in a person, that person **must** be surrounded in this world only by enemies who, without ceasing, would uproot and kill Christ.

<margin>* J. B.</margin>
2. This is the path of all true Christians, for they must walk through the Devil’s thorns in this world. This is currently the case with the name of the author of that despised book, as well as with his person. Satan raises his stormy winds against the gifts of the Holy Spirit and will not tolerate Christ in his members. As is seen in this hostile <note>original: "enimicitious" — full of enmity or hostility</note> libel, one can see how enraged *Satan* is, how abominably he slanders and reproaches the *Author*, and how he sets himself up as a *Judge* <note>original: "Richter" — Boehme is making a pun on Gregory Richter’s surname, as "Richter" is the German word for "judge."</note> over God's work, seeking to suppress and uproot it.

3. Dear reader and brother in Christ who loves God: although I am an enemy at heart to such accursed, unworthy, and reproachful writings of *controversy*—not considering these published <note>original: "divulged"</note> insults (which are contrary to Christian love and truth) worthy of any answer at all—yet for the sake of the command and love of my Lord Jesus Christ, I would provide an answer. I do this for the sake of those who do not understand the matter and have not read my little book on *True Repentance* and *Resignation, as the Way to Christ*, nor know me personally. These people only regard the respect and favor of the *Primate* <note>original: "Primate" — referring to the high-ranking clergyman Gregory Richter</note>, and they suppose he reproaches me out of Christian zeal and does it for God’s sake in respect to his office or ministry.

4. Since the most part of them are thus led astray to applaud him—thinking he is right and that everything he shouts from the **pulpit** is true—he hides the matter by using God’s name. In doing so, he cloaks the situation so that men cannot see his fierce, wrathful heart. He appeals to his office and ministry, and the simple people—who know nothing of his dealings, how maliciously he persecutes me and acts completely contrary to his office, and who will never examine me about it—condemn what he himself does NOT understand. Therefore, I have provided an answer to see whether any will become clear-sighted and stop reproaching the gift of God.

5. And I *herewith* testify in the presence of God that I have answered with no other intention than purely for the sake of love for our neighbor.

6. And I *admonish* the *Primate* to think better of me, for he does not have a lion to deal with, but a lamb of JESUS CHRIST. Otherwise, he will find out whom he has pierced <note>A reference to Zechariah 12:10 and John 19:37; Boehme suggests that by attacking him, Richter is attacking Christ</note>, lest the sheep, in the Spirit of Christ, becomes a lion, and the sheep judges the wolf. And I mean this heartily and faithfully.

->*Jacob Boehme.*<-

<summary>Jacob Boehme introduces his defense against Gregory Richter, characterizing Richter's attacks as Satanic opposition to the Holy Spirit. Boehme explains that he writes not out of a desire for conflict, but to inform those who have been misled by Richter’s influential position in the church.</summary>

### Part 1. The simple people God has used. 4th Apology.

Life <note>This word continues the sentence from the previous page: "...and how a Christian [must lead his] life."</note> *is described; it shows who our Eternal Father is and what our Native Country is like, and how we may enter into it.*

*This doctrine is the true foundation of the New Testament, just as Christ and the Apostles have taught us.*

8. But since the writer of this libel says there are as many blasphemies against God in it as there are lines in that book, it is clear that he himself blasphemes and insults the Holy Spirit. He calls repentance and prayer a blasphemy against God, even though the book treats only of repentance and the *new birth*.

9. Dear *Mr. Judging Judge* <note>original: "Herr Richtender Richter" — Boehme is punning on his opponent's name, Gregory Richter; "Richter" is the German word for "judge."</note>, where will you go or where will you hide when the Supreme *Judge* <note>original: "Richter"</note>, CHRIST (whom you disgrace by attacking his followers), appears in his wrath? He will *judge the judging judge* <note>original: "Richten den Richtenden Richter"</note> and will himself be the law <note>original: "jus"</note>, the right, and the judgment.

10. That Judge <note>original: "Richter"</note> will not respect a high church official <note>original: "Primate"</note> or the followers he leads, nor any king, prince, or lord of the world based on the authority they once held, nor their laws, statutes, or institutions. Instead, he will judge the LIFE and test it in HIS fire.

11. Where will your insults and shaming go then—the ones you have directed at Christ through his followers? It is written: *Whoever blasphemes the Holy Spirit has no forgiveness forever* (Matthew 3:29). What will you answer him? You have knowingly blasphemed his gifts and so miserably persecuted the children of Christ. When Christ says, *Whatever you have done to the least of these my brothers, you have done to me,* what answer will you give then?

<margin>* A layman or an uneducated person.</margin>
12. You despise me because I am a layman <note>original: "Layick"</note> and did not come from the high schools or universities with my skills and knowledge. You cry "Fie!" upon my gifts, which I have received from God as a noble bounty—gifts that are more dear to me than the whole world. You insult my trade or craft <note>original: "Handicraft"</note> by crying "Fie!" on it, calling both it and my gift a "stench." How can things go well for you when these insults and blasphemies—by which you mock the gift of the Holy Spirit—awaken God's anger in your body and soul? When that fire is kindled, the world will become too small for you. What would you give later on to have never done such a thing?

13. The spirit that now makes you rejoice so that you can have your way with me through insults and shame—if that spirit should become a hellish fire and enter your conscience, where will you remain?

### 4th Apology. What simple people God has made use of. Part 1.

14. You force *tears* from me and earnest *prayers* against the shaming or blaspheming of *God*, because you blame me entirely with *untruth*. Take care that my *tears* do not become \* *burning coals upon your head* <margin>Romans 12:20</margin>.

15. I have prayed much to God for you, that God would enlighten you and give you the grace to acknowledge the truth; but you continually become *worse*. I will be blameless concerning you if God’s anger touches you.

16. Why do you despise me because I am a layman <note>original: "Layick"; a person without professional or specialized knowledge in a particular subject, specifically theology in this context.</note>, and yet have high *divine* and *natural knowledge*? Do you suppose the Holy Spirit is bound to your *schools* or *universities*? Did not our dearest Christ say: *My Father will give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him for it?* (Luke 11:13). Also: *Ask and you shall receive, seek and you shall find, knock and it will be opened unto you?* (Matthew 7:7).

17. I have received my gift through earnest PRAYER and knocking, and I cherish <note>original: "relish"</note> it so much that I would not trade it for all the world’s honors and goods; I also can never deny or forsake it. Why then do you attribute the *gift of God to the devil*?

18. Just look back at history: what kind of *simple people* has God used for his work? *What were Abel, Seth, Enoch, and Noah? What were the Patriarchs?* They were shepherds; none of them was a doctor of theology. *What was Moses?* A shepherd. *What was David?* A shepherd. *What were the prophets, especially Elisha and Habakkuk?* Honest, simple people who were farmers <note>original: "tillers of the ground"</note>. *What was Mary, the mother of our Lord CHRIST?* A poor, honest, and destitute young maid. *Who was the foster-father of Christ during his childhood?* A carpenter. *Who were Christ’s apostles, all of them?* Poor, simple craftsmen or tradesmen, such as fishermen and the like. *Why did Christ not reject them as well, seeing as they had not studied? Did HE cry out against them because they were working-class people <note>original: "handicrafts people"</note>, as you do?*

19. What was *Christian nobility* from the beginning? It was humility and the fear of God. Where now lies your great boasting in the *Scriptures*, or in your academic skill <note>original: "Art"; referring to the "Liberal Arts" or formal university learning.</note>? Show me. *Saint Paul* was a scribe, learned in the *Scriptures*, but <margin>1 Corinthians 3:18</margin> when he became a Christian, he first had to *become a fool to his academic skill and knowledge, so that divine wisdom might find a place in him*.

20. Why do you brag so much of your skill if you call yourself a Christian? Do you not know that we are ALL ONE in Christ, and that Christ is in us ALL? If Christ teaches us and loves us, why then do you curse us and call *Christ in US a "stink"*?

21. Moreover, does that not have a bad appearance or symptom, as if the evil spirit were in you, who cannot endure Christ? Nor would you willingly see men repent and pray, since you call *repentance and prayer a "stink"*? You cannot deny this, because you say that

<meta>catchword: every</meta>

He argues that the Holy Spirit is not confined to universities and warns his opponent against mocking the process of prayer and repentance.</summary>

# I.P. By Repentance the Gift of the Holy Spirit is attained. A. IV.

...every line is a blasphemy against God; and you forbid the people to read it under pain of eternal punishment.

22. Only open your *heart* and read that little book correctly; you will find something else *therein*. You have not read it at all *yet*—I perceive that by the title of your *libel* <note>original: "Libell"; a published statement that is damaging to a person's reputation.</note>—for you set down the title wrong. You have not seen the little book of *True Resignation*, or of the *Imitation* (or following) of *Christ* within it. You list the *Morning Redness* or *Aurora* <note>original: "Aurora"; Latin for "dawn." This was Boehme’s first major work.</note> as the *first* book, of which you know little or nothing, and *The Way to Christ* as the *second* book. Yet, that is no single book, but is only the *general* title; and the book of *Repentance* you set as the *third*, whereas it is the *first* in the printed book, and the *last* one, you have never seen.

<margin>* I have known others who have condemned a book before they had read it — H. B.</margin>

23. O *Primate*! Satan has blinded you and led you into *anger*, so that because of your anger you could not even read it. Instead, he has instantly hurried you toward reproaches and scandalizing; for it is a stench in his eyes. Thus, you have imitated and followed *him*. Simply drive away *evil* affections from you and read it correctly, and you will see things very differently.

24. Also, you know that God has converted *some* people by it, so that they have entered into true repentance and have attained *that very thing* which *Christ* has promised us: that is to say, the *gift* of the *Holy Spirit* (Luke 11:13). There are eminent examples nearby.

25. These men's gifts of the Holy Spirit you call a *stench* <note>original: "stink"</note>. By this, *men* may espy and discern that this little book is altogether *against* the devil, and that no good spirit can dwell in you while you blaspheme the gift of *God*. For you say this "stench"—namely, *repentance* and *prayer*, which are the whole contents of this book—should be far from you. It may well come to pass that God’s gifts shall indeed be removed and be far from you.

->**The Libel**<-

26. *You also say that great plagues hang over those places where such blasphemy against God may be devised, published, and believed without punishment; where men may also freely, without interruption, think, write, believe, and publish whatever they will.*

->**The Answer**<-

27. Yes, I believe so too: that great punishments hang over those places where men blaspheme the gifts of God and ascribe them to the devil. Also, there hangs over the earthly man...

### IV. Apology: In Repentance, the Earthly Man is Daily Killed. Part I.
<meta>Catchword: Libel.</meta>

27. Where such an earnest, sincere repentance is exercised, there is clearly great punishment, for the "earthly man" must be daily killed <note>original: "killed"; referring to the mystical process of "mortification," where the selfish nature of the individual is surrendered to God.</note> and be made a fool to the world when he walks in the divine way.

28. You see very well how I am punished by you in such ways—and not only by you, but you egg on and incite the whole city to heap reproaches upon my neck, so that they believe you and punish me. But this is the badge, character, or mark of Christ.

29. But as for your desire to prescribe a model or platform of **FAITH** for the people—so that they should not each believe in their own divine gift as the Spirit of God reveals itself in their souls—another libel would be required for that; this one is not sufficient for that purpose.

30. But that you threaten them with punishment—that I believe you would do very well. If you had the power, they would have to go either into the fire or out of the land or country.

<margin>* Devised <note>original: "Erdachte"; something invented or made up by human intellect rather than divine revelation.</note></margin>
31. But when you say the way to repentance is a **devised doctrine**, the New Testament does not say so. For when Christ began his Gospel with John the Baptist, he said, "Repent" (Mark 1:15), and my book says the same.

<margin>1 Corinthians 2</margin>
32. The natural man receives or perceives nothing of this way (1 Corinthians 2:14). You do not need to punish him; he goes far enough in the ways of the Devil without that, until Christ enlightens him through repentance. Now, look at yourself and test yourself to see if you are in such a way before you prescribe limits and bounds to me and other children of God regarding our gifts from God—especially since your prescription is nothing but a defaming, disgraceful libel.

->Libel<-

33. *The libel further says: "God will wonderfully rescue His honor and will not allow His eternity to be taken away by such sectarian or swarming <note>original: "swarming"; a translation of the German "Schwärmer," a derogatory term used by established churches for religious radicals or "fanatics" who claimed direct inspiration from the Holy Spirit.</note> shoemakers, tanners, tailors, women, priests, and doctors."*

->Answer<-

34. I hold the same opinion and steadfastly believe that God will not allow His honor—which He has revealed in poor men through **JESUS CHRIST** and the victory over death and hell—to be taken away by any devil, much less a primate, doctor, priest, shoemaker, tailor, tanner, or woman. Instead, whoever among these shall repent and turn to Him, He will bestow His honor upon them. I also firmly believe that He will deliver His children from all evil and save them.

### The Libel <note>original: "Libell."; a formal written statement of an accusation or charge.</note>

35. The poison of Arius <note>original: "Arrius"; a 4th-century priest who taught that Jesus Christ was a created being and not co-eternal with God the Father, a belief condemned as heresy.</note>, *which denies the eternity of the Son of God, was not so bad and pernicious as this poison of the Shoemaker <note>Boehme was famously a shoemaker by trade, a fact his critics used to mock his lack of formal theological training.</note>, which takes away eternity from the Eternal Father and, in a blasphemous way against God, teaches a **Quaternity** <note>original: "four-foldnesse"; the heretical idea that there are four persons or principles in the Godhead instead of the Trinity.</note> within God.*

36. *Because of the heresy of Arius, the Eastern countries have been horribly punished with Islamic darkness <note>original: "Mahumetan darknesse"; referring to the rise of the Ottoman Empire and the spread of Islam in formerly Christian Byzantine lands.</note>. What kind of horrible darkness should we then expect if we do not, with diligent earnestness, hunt away and root out this poison from our native country?*

### Answer:

37. To this I say clearly, NO; you cannot for all eternity prove that I take away eternity from the Father, much less that I teach a *four-fold nature* <note>original: "Quaternity"</note> of the *Deity*; you have for a long time groundlessly attributed that to me, quoting my writings with a distorted understanding. You have said from the pulpit that I have written that the Son of God was made of ***Mercury*** <note>original: "Quick-Silver"; in his mystical writings, Boehme used alchemical terms like "mercury" metaphorically to describe spiritual qualities, which his critics interpreted literally to mock him.</note>. You should prove that; otherwise, it shall remain eternally an untruth. Regarding such an untruth, one might well say, "For shame!"

38. **I acknowledge ONE God only;** who is the eternal, beginningless, and only good Substance <note>original: "Substance"; here meaning the underlying essence or reality of God.</note>, who dwells everywhere—outside of, beyond, or distinct from all nature and creatures—within himself. He needs no space or place and is subject to no measurability, much less to any

<meta>catchword: any</meta>

# IV. Apology: The Summary of Jacob Boehme’s Demonstrations, Part 1

...any comprehension of nature and created things.

<margin>
There is a Trinity of properties in the Godhead—not of persons in the way we think of the soul, body, and spirit of a man (who, if regenerated, becomes an image and likeness of the Godhead). God is Life itself, and man is a recipient of life. Jesus Christ is—**NOTE**—the manifested Godhead, in whom the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily.
</margin>

39. And I do acknowledge that this one and only God is **threefold in persons**, equal in omnipotence and power: namely, **Father, Son, and Holy Spirit**. I acknowledge that this **triune substance** fills all things equally at once, and has also been the foundation and beginning of all things, and still is, and will remain so eternally.

40. Moreover, I believe and acknowledge that the **eternal power**—that is, the divine breathing or speaking—has flowed forth and become visible. In this out-flowing Word, the inward Heaven and the **visible** world exist, together with every created substance; and God has made all things by his Word.

41. Regarding what I have written in the *Aurora* <note>Boehme’s first book, *Aurora, or the Morning Redness* (1612), which mixed theology with alchemical metaphors.</note> about **Salniter** <note>original: "Salniter"; a term Boehme adapted from "sal niter" (saltpeter), using it to describe a divine, explosive "salt" or essential energy within nature.</note> and **Mercury**, I do NOT mean by those terms the pure GOD himself. I mean HIS out-flowing substantial Word—that is, a **shadow of the inward foundation** <note>original: "Ground"</note> through which the Word has introduced itself into a natural operation, and thereby made that material. In this way, I demonstrate the three principles in nature, which are: a spiritual Mercury...

...things, even the depths of the Deity. (1 Corinthians 2:10).

46. 47. If you see any of them, you say he is the Devil; you put reproachful, blasphemous names upon him and cry out that men should **banish** him from the city and the country. Please, show your **Christian heart** in your **banishing**.

It does not say to hunt him out, reproach him, and condemn him unheard, as you have done to me.

# Part I. Why God took the Candlestick from the Eastern Countries. IV. Apology.

...I have no such ill thoughts of them as you have. Indeed, one may find people among them just as learned as you are; surely you are not the only one who has studied. 53. But all the works of God must serve Him. God has used you as an instrument for the publication of these works, which God has granted me to know. Therefore, for a long time I have patiently borne your unjust reproaches and disgraces, in which there has not yet been one *true* word. Otherwise, I would have answered you long ago.

<margin>

<margin>

# The Second Part in the Libel

## The Libel says:

->71.<-

The libel says: "The Shoemaker <note>term: "Shoemaker" refers to Jacob Boehme himself, who was a master shoemaker by trade; Richter used Boehme's humble profession to mock his spiritual authority.</note> is the Antichrist."

->Answer<-

72. If I were to describe the *Antichrist*, I could not demonstrate him in any other way than as one who calls himself a Christian and *covers himself with Christ's purple mantle*. He acknowledges and teaches Christ with his *mouth*, but his *heart* is set entirely against Christ. He teaches one thing and does another. Outwardly he calls himself a *Christian*, but inwardly he is a *serpent*. He persecutes Christ in his members and resists the Spirit of Christ. He flatters and plays the hypocrite, wanting to be honored in Christ’s name, but is *inwardly a devouring wolf*—just as Christ calls the *Pharisees, who sat in Moses' seat and administered the Law* (Matthew 7:15). But Christ said *they were from below, from the father of this world, namely from the Devil* (John 8:23, 24).

73. By this, I do not wish to touch or disturb the good conscience of anyone; but I would ask the libeller whether *a young Antichrist is not peeping out of the shell.*

->Libel<-

74. *You, meek and gentle Lord CHRIST, say: "My word is true and faithful." And you, perjured shoemaker, say also: "My words are true." Which of the two should now be given credit and faith? To YOU, the true and faithful Christ? Or to you, Shoemaker, and your dung?* <note>original: "Dung" – This reflects the vulgar and aggressive language Richter used in his Latin pamphlets to describe Boehme’s mystical writings.</note>

I desire to lead no one away from Christ, but I show them sincerely and heartily how they should come to Christ my Savior through true repentance and prayer—just as my little printed book <note>This likely refers to Boehme's book *The Way to Christ*.</note> teaches throughout and nothing else.

79. Why then do you separate me from Christ and call my words—which point to Christ—"dung"? It is a sign that the way of repentance which leads to Christ stinks like filth to you. This is the true character of the Antichrist; for the libeller spits "fie" <note>original: "Fy" – an exclamation of disgust or disapproval.</note> and filth against the repentance and the very earnest prayers in my little book, and calls them a stench.

Since he insists on forcing that label upon me, I offer this so it might be considered and known from whom he truly comes.

# IV. Apology: Defamation forbidden in the Laws. Part II.

->Libel <note>original: "Libell" – a published false statement that is damaging to a person's reputation.</note><-

81. Moreover, the libel calls me a "perjured shoemaker," and from the pulpit he has called me a "rascally knave" <note>original: "knave" – a dishonest or unscrupulous man.</note>.

->Answer<-

82. This reproachful defamation is forbidden in all **statutes** and **laws of the Empire** under penalty of severe punishment, so that no one should disgrace another's good name and honor, or create any defamatory libel or disgraceful writings. He should be the man who forbids others from doing this, yet he does it himself.

83. *O Primate!* <note>original: "Primate" – here referring to Gregorius Richter, the Primary Pastor (Pastor Primarius) of the city.</note> I ask you: if I had caused such a libel to be printed against you, and had so abominably vilified and disgraced you, to what place would you have sent it and condemned it? Surely to the gallows, and the author along with it. But what shall I say to you? Only this: *God forgive you.*

84. This oath I have firmly kept to this very hour. Yet you call me a *perjured* or forsworn fellow and a "rascally knave." I brought my honor and reputation to Görlitz, and you would strip me of it; for a perjured man is not *good enough* to be in anyone's company.

85. Well now, you should and ought to demonstrate that I am such a person, and appeal with an earnest complaint to the magistrate to implore justice and protection. # IV. Apology. Where filth is in the Mouth, there is Satan. Part II.

*The Antichrist cried out, "They are heretics!" Men had no other cause to bring against them, yet execution proceeded based on that alone.*

94. Oh, how these heretics will be set before your eyes at the last Day of Judgment! When they are placed in the *divine power* with Christ at the judgment to judge the *Antichrist*, who has persecuted and killed them; what will you then answer to CHRIST and to me, when your libel <note>original: "Libell" — a published defamatory statement or pamphlet intended to ruin someone's reputation.</note> burns within your soul? Who gave you the authority to judge in such a way? Prove it from the *Apostles' doctrine*. There is still time to repent before I must—driven by God—summon you before the severe judgment of *Jesus Christ*. Observe what I say to you! I am a Christian in Christ, yet *you call Christ in his member a heretic*, and you call his power "dirt" or "dung."

95. The mercifulness of Christ calls you *through this*, yet once more, to see whether you will repent. If not, I will be blameless concerning you; if you are placed in the judgment, you have a great mountain before you which you must climb. Then, if *Christ* leaves you, you may well remain eternally in this abyss <note>original: "Cliffe" — Boehme is referencing the "great gulf" or chasm mentioned in the parable of the Rich Man and Lazarus in Luke 16:26.</note>.

96. Observe what is said to you: it is well known that hypocrisy accomplishes nothing; there must be earnest sincerity. To sin because of grace <note>original: "sinne upon Grace" — the idea of continuing to sin intentionally while presuming that God's grace will automatically cover it.</note> makes a person incapable of receiving grace. The hour is near; be convinced that you will have no such protector or assistant there as those you gather to yourself here and rely upon. You must stand before *my eyes* and give an account for your malice and your reproachful blasphemy.

97. *Christ* within me, and in all the members of Christ, summons you before the judgment of *Christ*. What shall I then say to you for all the scandalous insults you have placed upon me *here on earth*? I pray you, as a fellow member of my soul, convert now while the door of grace stands open, before the great *cliff* or *gulf* between me and you is shut (*Luke 16:26*).

98. It indeed becomes **A High Priest** very poorly—one who should bring the *Divine Word* of Christ’s love into his mouth—to instead take filth into his mouth and pollute Christ's word, which he should teach. You pollute it with filth and spit such filth into the hearts of the people, poisoning them as you do. For where filth is, *the Holy Spirit is not in that mouth at all; only Satan is there.*

99. The Christian Church or *Congregation* would do well to open its eyes and observe what men are teaching them. God's punishment follows; be convinced, dear brothers, there will shortly come a time when you will clearly see what I am saying here.

I am a Christian in Christ; *you call Christ, within his own member, a heretic*, and you call his power "dirt" or "dung."

<insert>{</insert> 95. The mercy of Christ calls to you *through this*, yet once more, to see whether you will repent. If not, I will be blameless concerning you. If you are placed in that judgment, you will have a great mountain before you through which you must climb; then, if *Christ* leaves you, you may well remain eternally in this abyss <note>original: "Cliffe" — used here to mean a steep drop-off or a spiritual divide.</note>.

<insert>{</insert> 96. Observe what is said to you. It is well known that hypocrisy achieves nothing; there must be earnest sincerity. To sin because you rely on grace <note>original: "to sinne upon Grace" — the presumption that one can sin freely because God is obligated to forgive.</note> makes a man incapable of receiving grace. The hour is near; be convinced, you will have no such protector or assistance there as you gather for yourself here and rely upon. You must stand before *my eyes* and give an account for your malice and insulting blasphemy.

97. *Christ* in me, and in all the members of Christ, summons you before the judgment of Christ. What shall I then say to you for all the scandalous blemishes you have put upon me *here on earth*? I pray you, as a fellow member of my soul, convert while the door of grace stands open, before the great *cliff* or *gulf* between *me and you is shut*: Luke 16:26 <note>This refers to the "great chasm" fixed between heaven and hell in the parable of the Rich Man and Lazarus.</note>.

98. It becomes **a High Priest** indeed very poorly—one who should bring the *Divine Word* of the love of Christ into his mouth—if instead he takes filth into his mouth and pollutes *Christ’s word*, which he should teach. You pollute it with filth and spit such filth into the hearts of the people, poisoning them as you do. For where filth is, **the Holy Spirit is not in that mouth at all; but Satan is.**

<insert>{</insert> 99. The Christian church or congregation would do well to open its eyes and observe what it is men are teaching them; the punishment of God follows. Be convinced, dear brethren, there will shortly come a time wherein you will clearly see what I am saying here.

# Part II. The Anointing is the true Door to the Sheep. Apology IV.

->The Accusation<-

100. "Christ taught men the divine commandments, but *this fellow teaches the art of seduction with great earnestness.*"

->The Answer<-

<margin>Seduction <note>original: "Versue-kung," an archaic spelling of *Versuchung*, meaning temptation or seduction.</note></margin>
101. Where is it written in my book that I teach men an outward separation? Show me that, or else it is not so. I teach them the anointing <note>original: "Unction" — the ceremonial act of smearing with oil, used here to mean the spiritual empowerment of the believer.</note> of *Jesus Christ*, along with his delicate humanity in a spiritual way, WITHIN <insert>us</insert>, according to the internal ground of faith. Concerning this, CHRIST says, *he who eats my flesh and drinks my blood, he continues in me and I in him* (John 6:56).

102. For THAT is the temple of the Holy Spirit, *where Christ’s flesh and blood continues in us*, as Saint *Paul* says: 1 Corinthians 6:19. It is also the NEW regeneration <note>original: "Regeneration" — the process of being spiritually reborn.</note>, in which the HOLY SPIRIT WITHIN <insert>us</insert> SEARCHES THE DEPTHS OF THE DEITY: 1 Corinthians 2:10. It is the poured-out word of *substantial* divine love, which marries and incorporates itself with our soul, as the entire *New Testament* teaches.

103. Where it is written: *Test whether Christ has taken a form in you* (Galatians 4:19). If *Christ* is to take a form in <insert>us</insert>, then that presence must not be absent. If we are to be a branch on that vine of *Christ*, then we must not cling to another: *for no one can serve two masters*, says *Christ* (Matthew 6:24). Also, *My Father will give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him for it; when he comes, he will declare me in you* (Luke 11:13; John 16:14).

<margin>Hebrews 1:9</margin>
104. It is not an *outward* seduction, but an *inward* enlightening, from which the soul—when it tastes this *Oil of Joy and Gladness*—reaches such great rejoicing as is mentioned in my little book concerning the **Noble Sophia** <note>Sophia: The Greek word for "Wisdom," personified in Boehme’s theology as the "Bride of the Soul" and the mirror of God’s glory.</note>; which is the substantial love of JESUS CHRIST.

<margin>Enthusiasts <note>original: "Enthusiastris" — a derogatory term used by the orthodox church to describe those who claimed direct, personal inspiration from God.</note></margin>
105. I understand very well that you do not know this *Noble Sophia*. It is not a good sign that you deny her and call her an *enthusiast*. I know her well and have a love for her, for she is my soul's dear *bride*. If I did not know her, then surely I would not have suffered so very much for the sake of her love from you and other people.

<margin>John 10:8–14</margin>
106. Christ says in *John 10*, *Whoever does not enter through me to the sheep—that is, into the sheepfold—but climbs in some other way, he is a thief and a murderer, and merely a hired hand. He has come only with cunning to rob the sheep of their food and to shear off their wool.* These belong to the *wolves* and do not have the shepherd’s crook or staff of Christ, but the Devil's shears, and must hereafter howl eternally with the wolves. But YOU say that he who does not enter through the high schools or universities is a thief and a murderer, and so you mock the door of CHRIST.

CHRIST, namely the anointing <note>original: "Unction" — the spiritual empowerment or "smearing" with the Holy Spirit</note> of the Holy Spirit, and insists that men must draw divine knowledge and skill only from the high schools or *universities*, and tries to bind and tie up God’s gifts to formal study <note>original: "Art" — referring here to academic or human scholarship</note>.

<margin>Matthew 11:25, Luke 1:52</margin>
107. But Christ teaches us quite differently: that *this thing is hidden from the wise and clever, and revealed to the seeking and hungry children* (Matthew 11:25). As *Mary* also says: *He has brought down the mighty from their thrones, and exalted the miserable and lowly, who are humble in their hearts before him* (Luke 1:52). She does not mean worldly might and authority, but spiritual spirit and power.

<margin>* Romans 13:13, 14; Ephesians 2:3</margin>
108. O *Primate* <note>original: "Primate" — a title for a high-ranking bishop or church leader, here used to address Richter</note>! I have much to say to you here, but I do not know if it would be well-spent, for *you only want to cover yourself with Christ’s purple robe* so that you might live \* *according to the desires of the flesh.* You do not want to be reborn and daily die *to sin*, but only want to comfort yourself *with the fact that it was Christ* who did the work.

109. But I tell you, it will not help you unless you put on Christ's *atonement* <note>original: "Satisfaction"</note> through earnest repentance and turning toward grace. You must become a *branch* on the stem of Christ the Vine, so that Christ may also kill sin in you and *renew* your senses, thoughts, and mind. Only then will you desire to imitate Christ; otherwise, your emotional excitement <note>original: "tickling"</note> will be useless and will be only a hypocritical, flattering show.

<margin>† John 3:27</margin>
110. I tell you this in love; observe it well. I have received this from God, so I know it, and the *New Testament* teaches you the same thing throughout. In my little book, I have clearly shown you that no one knows or understands this noble *Sophia* <note>original: "Sophia" — Greek for "Wisdom," personified in Boehme’s theology as the bride of the soul</note> through the felt or *experienced* <note>original: "Experimentall"</note> love of JESUS CHRIST † *unless it is given to him by God* (John 3:27).

111. I will not cast the pearl before your feet any further until you are fit and prepared for it through true repentance. If that were done, as I wish, then I would speak further with you about it; but for now, you are not yet worthy of it, seeing as you despise it.

112. For that reason, your teaching is cold because you do not have this power within you. You do not yet have the right *hammer* to strike the bell <note>original: "Clock"</note>; you cannot yet strike the bell that awakens the poor captive soul. You must use the right hammer if you want to strike the right hour and wake the soul from sleep. You have the WORD indeed, but the right power is not in you to work together with the *literal word itself*. Therefore Christ said, *The sheep do not hear the voice of the hired hand* (John 10:3), for his crying and calling is mere *deception* <note>original: "jugling"</note> and a fight with a shadow. Without God’s hammer, he is—with all his teaching—merely a trickster: a "belly-hammer" <note>Boehme implies the preacher works only to fill his belly/earn a living</note>, an "ear-hammer" <note>someone who makes noise for the ears only</note>, and not a "soul-hammer."

113. This power, which I mean, is the *Dove* to the *Sheep*. You often use your blasphemous reproaches—*Satan's Hammer*—under *Christ’s Purple Mantle*. Your heart is *full of gall and bitterness*. Oh, alas, it is time! Repent!

->Answer<-

115. I do not lead men away from the **preached and written Word;** you do me wrong in that. Instead, I say that they should bring the **Temple of JESUS CHRIST** along with them to the preached or written word—namely, a *repentant, hungry soul* which hears Christ within itself. This is the **LIVING Word** within the *literal* and preached Word; as *David* says: *I will hear what the Lord says within me* (Psalm 85:8 <note>original: "Psal. 85. 9." — in modern Bibles, this verse is usually numbered 85:8</note>). And Christ also says: *He who is of God hears God's word;* and to the Pharisees he says: *Therefore you do not hear, because you are not of God* (John 8:47). Also: *You are not my sheep* (John 10:26).

116. What I mean by this is that a man should have divine ears—namely, a repentant soul—if he wishes to hear Christ's voice, whether in **preaching**, **reading**, or **conversation** <note>original: "Conference"</note>. For Christ has taught us this, and I believe Him more than I do all academic study <note>original: "ART" — referring here to human scholarship or theology without spiritual life</note> whatsoever. For historical faith—to tickle and comfort oneself with knowledge without spiritual power and an earnest, sincere will—is dead and is nothing but a * shell <margin>* husk</margin>. It does not achieve divine childship <note>original: "Childship or Filiation" — the state of being a child of God</note>; it must be earnest sincerity that does it.

<margin>
* Sometimes all tares and no wheat
</margin>
117. It is not enough that we go to *church* and to the *Sacrament* and sit there for an hour, playing the hypocrite and hearing a *sermon* in which * wheat and tares <note>original: "Wheat and Tares" — a reference to the parable in Matthew 13 where weeds grow among the grain</note> are often sown together, mixed with one another, while you frequently reproach and blaspheme. No, going to *church* makes no one virtuous or honest unless he hears God's Word *effectively* <note>original: "operatively"</note> in his soul. For the Lord says through His prophets: *They draw near to me with their lips, but their heart is far from me* (Isaiah 29:13 <note>original: "Ezek: 29. 13." — the quote actually comes from Isaiah 29:13, though similar themes appear in Ezekiel</note>).

# Part II. Men should teach Love, not Contention. Apology IV.

<header>IV. Apol. Men should teach Love, not Contention. Part. II.</header>

<note>Large curly brackets in the left margin group paragraphs 119-120 and paragraphs 121-122.</note>

118. "Not everyone who goes to church and says, 'Lord, Lord,' shall enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but those who do the will of my Father in Heaven," says Christ in Matthew 7:21 <note>original: "Matth: 7. 2." — Boehme likely refers to Matthew 7:21.</note>. It must not be an intellectual or **historical belief** <note>original: "Historicall believing" — a belief based only on historical facts or intellectual assent rather than personal spiritual experience.</note> alone, but a powerful **doing**. Now, if they are to do the Divine will, then that same will—namely, the Spirit of **CHRIST**—must work powerfully **WITHIN** them; for Christ says, "without **ME** you can do nothing" (John 15:5).

119. Therefore, flattering **hypocrisy** and **lukewarmness** are of no use. For true faith is not merely an imprinted or mental image, but it is power, Spirit, and Life. It is a fire of the Divine word that burns there and shines outward, working together with God. The right and true Faith is the seat of God, upon which He sits and speaks.

120. Faith is not mere **historical breath** <note>original: "historicall Breath" — empty words or intellectual talk without spiritual substance.</note>, with which a man only comforts himself while flattering the **evil beast** within, who is full of false and wicked desires. No, it is a living, working power of God. Its burning fire is the flame of God's love, which breaks forth and performs the work.

121. Your preaching is completely useless if **CHRIST** does not work through your word in the listeners. But if that is to happen, then you **must** teach them **LOVE**, not disgraceful and contemptuous conflict. You must remove the filth and scorn from your mouth, and not judge falsely, blaspheme, or reproach. For in reproaches, **SATAN** works; but within a pure soul, **CHRIST** works. Reproaching is the work of the **ANTICHRIST**.

122. But as for your claim that I direct men toward **dreams**, that is worth no answer, for it is not so. This reproach is also a signature or sign of the Antichrist, which thus defiles the children of Christ. Prove it, or it is not true.

<margin>
X This has been their effect in me to some happy degree.
M: 13-18
Praise the Lord
</margin>
123. You also say that my **dreams**—for that is what you consider my writings to be—rob believing hearts of **FAITH**. That is also not true. Instead, they lead men away from a **historical faith** and from hypocrisy toward the **living faith**, which is **JESUS CHRIST**. They show men how they should daily die to sin, be born anew in Christ, and imitate or follow Him in faith and Spirit, becoming **ONE** Spirit with Christ. X

124. This makes the Devil afraid that men will no longer tolerate him under **Christ’s purple mantle** <note>original: "Christs Purple Mantle" — a metaphor for using religious authority or outward piety to hide corruption.</note>. But the time is born or has come for his kingdom to be revealed and brought to shame, which no **primate** <note>original: "Primate" — a high-ranking bishop or church authority.</note> shall prevent; it is so ordained by God.

125. **CHRIST** handled weighty matters,

...but the Shoemaker, *slight contemptible matters*.

### Answer.

126. Christ has brought and showed us the way to blessedness and salvation, and the Shoemaker <note>The "Shoemaker" is Jacob Boehme himself, who worked as a cobbler while writing his mystical treatises.</note> desires to walk in it. But Satan calls it a slight and contemptible way, seeing it is a *cross-way* <note>original: "Crosse-way" — referring to the *via crucis*, the path of suffering and humility modeled by Christ's crucifixion.</note>, in which a person in this world must follow or imitate Christ in misery and humility. For Satan is a spirit of pride, and therefore he despises the path of Christ's pilgrimage; because this way is straight and narrow, it does not please the *fat belly* and the eyes that are full of their *own honor* and self-interest.

127. Christ has destroyed Satan's kingdom and generated Christianity, but the Antichrist has set himself in Christ's seat. The Shoemaker reveals or manifests this according to the will of God, and the Primate <note>original: "Primate" — refers to Gregorius Richter, the primary pastor of Görlitz and Boehme's chief antagonist.</note> supposes that to be a slight, contemptible matter. But when the hour strikes *Seven* <note>original: "Seaven" — in Boehme's prophetic system, the "Seventh Hour" or the number seven often refers to the completion of divine judgment and the manifestation of God's kingdom.</note>, then it will have been a good matter.
<margin>* Note: See the first Apology against *Balthazar Tylcken*, verse 540.</margin>

### Libel <note>original: "Libell" — a published statement that damages a person's reputation; here, it refers to Richter's written accusations.</note>.

128. Christ despised worldly riches, but the Shoemaker *desires them*.

### Answer.

<margin>† Matthew 11:28.</margin>
129. CHRIST said, *Come to me, all you who labor and are heavy laden* (Matthew 11:28). He made no distinction between the rich and the poor who came to him. But the Primate is troubled that a layman <note>original: "Layick"</note> is helped by rich people who fear God. Because of this, it seems likely he supposes something is being taken away from him; he thinks it belongs to him *alone* to converse with the rich for his own profit, and that riches belong to him. On the contrary, the Shoemaker desires no *great riches* in this world, for he *is not* proud, as people may well see by his life.

### 133. Christ has abstained from unnecessary laughter, but the Shoemaker laughs in everything he says.

->Answer<-

134. People do not *find* that Christ ever laughed, but only rejoiced in Spirit. But the *Primate* <note>original: "Primate" — refers to Gregorius Richter, the primary pastor of Görlitz and Boehme's chief antagonist.</note> has attributed laughter and whimsy to the Shoemaker and says he laughs at every word; that is indeed an open, gross untruth and cannot be proven. Neither can any honest, faithful man say it. But Nature gives one person a tendency to laugh and to be friendly and approachable more than another, while it makes another a gloomy, sour, grim-looking man; the Primate cannot change that. He would do well to be silent in that matter. If a man were to describe him and the foolish insults which he often gives during his drinking bouts and quaffing, one would be forced to reveal some strange monsters.

<margin>* Marcolphus is a fictional character in German folklore portrayed as Solomon's jester. When he was condemned to be hanged, he asked the King to let him choose the tree upon which he must be executed. This being granted, he searched for a while, and when asked which tree he...</margin>
135. I am seized with wonder that he is not ashamed—being an old man in whom one should seek wisdom—that he dares to write such obvious untruths and foolish, mocking expressions. He causes an honest man of good reputation to be oppressed with scorn. These expressions are even worse than those of a common, jeering, mocking jester. This libel is very much like the filthy, vulgar scoffs of *Marcolphus <note>A legendary figure representing coarse, worldly wit contrasted with King Solomon's wisdom.</note>, who always carries filth in his mouth, just as this *libel* also does.

136. It brings very little respect to a teacher of Christ—who should forbid such behavior in others and yet does it himself. The *Shepherd's* office <note>The role of a pastor or minister.</note> will be poorly served by this. No one should trust his soul to such mockings; he will be deceived. This spirit stands upon sand and totters to and fro. People may *test him now* by such scoffs.

137. A bird is well known by its feathers. Christ said: *That which is within comes out; whatever the heart is full of, that comes out of the mouth. Also, how can you who are evil speak what is good? Also, can a man gather grapes from thistles, or figs from thorns? A good man brings forth good out of the treasure of his heart, and an evil man brings forth evil out of the treasure of his evil heart.* (Luke 6:45) <note>original: "Luke 16. 45" — the text actually appears in Luke 6:45.</note>

<header>II. Part. Christ taught in the Wilderness. Apol. IV.</header>

138. <margin>...he could not find any that he could choose, and so escaped for that time;</margin>
I give this now to the reader to ponder: what kind of "good treasure" can the Primate <note>original: "Primate" — refers to Gregorius Richter, the primary pastor of Görlitz and Boehme's chief antagonist.</note> have in his heart when he brings forth such strange things from it? There must certainly be many odd things stuck inside him, which he really should be a little ashamed to bring out, seeing as he is the High Priest. But if a man comes to him and displeases him with just one word, then one may often hear Satan laughing out from him with insults and blasphemies.

->Libel <note>original: "Libell" — a published statement that damages a person's reputation; here, it refers to the written accusations by Richter.</note><-

139. **When Christ taught the people, he did it openly; but the Shoemaker <note>Jacob Boehme, who was a cobbler by trade.</note> is accustomed to creeping into secret corners.**

->Answer<-

<margin>* Or Art.</margin>
140. Christ was a teacher sent from God, and yet he often had to depart from the Pharisees and Scribes (who were learned in the Scriptures) and go into the wilderness to teach the people. When they saw him teach, they wanted to kill him and called him a deceiver and a troublemaker <note>original: "maker of uproars"</note>. They said he had his skill <note>original: "* skill or Art"</note> and doctrine from the Devil. Although they saw the wondrous signs and miracles, they were so angry and hardened; they assumed that teaching belonged only to them. They treated him just as the Primate treats the Shoemaker. <margin>† Matthew 11:19, Luke 7:34.</margin> They called him a drunkard <note>original: "Wine-bibber"</note> and a servant to wealthy tax collectors <note>original: "Publicans"</note>. John the Baptist also preached in the wilderness; indeed, the Gospel of Christ began in the wilderness with John. The Apostles also, for fear of the High Priests, often had to teach in corners and houses, as the Acts of the Apostles testifies.

141. But the Shoemaker is no preacher; he only gives an account of his gift and knowledge. He speaks often with honest hearts concerning *The Way to Christ*, explaining how we must convert, repent, and be born again <note>original: "new-born"</note>. For Christ also says this: *Where two or three of you are met together in my name, there am I in the midst of them (Matthew 18:20).*

A large glass of wine at his meetings is better liked by him than **a hearty, blessed conference concerning the New Birth.**

# H. P. J. B. Desires the highest Kingly Title of Christ over Death and Hell. A. IV.
<note>H. P. J. B. likely refers to "The Honorable Person Jacob Boehme." A. IV refers to the fourth article of his defense.</note>

-> Answer <-

149. The will of his Father was Christ's title; his honor was in God, and he brought it into our humanity and exalted our humanity to the right hand of the power of God. That very honor *he has bestowed* upon his Christians, so that they also in him *sit at the right hand of the power of God* and reign over sin, death, the devil, hell, and the world. This high title also "the Shoemaker" <note>Boehme refers to himself by the trade his opponent used to mock him.</note> claims for himself. He desires *the highest kingly title* in the victory of our Lord Jesus Christ—as a champion over death and hell. He desires such a high title so that he may stand in the struggle against death and hell, and so that, in Christ, he intends to conquer and overcome the whole world. He wishes to be a king in Christ and to rule over all the hostile <note>original: "Enimicitious" — full of enmity or hostility.</note> libels and reproaches of the *Primate* <note>The chief pastor, Gregorius Richter.</note>. Otherwise, he desires no worldly titles, for *the Kingdom of a Christian is not of this world* (John 18:36 <note>The original text cites John 15:19, but the quote "not of this world" is from 18:36.</note>), for Christ says, *I have called you out of the world, so that you may be where I am* (John 17:24).

150. But the *Primate* does desire a title, for he has set *his* titles of the High-Priest's Office and of his person in the libel in GREAT LETTERS, so that men might see the *Judge* <note>original: "Richter" — Boehme is punning on his opponent's name, Gregorius Richter, which means "judge" in German.</note>, or JUDGE, who has authority over Christ's children. Furthermore, if someone were to come a little too near him and simply forgot to take off his hat out of fear, he might well expect some strange kind of "title" <note>meaning: name-calling or insults.</note> from him, if he were not kicked for his efforts.

### IV. Apology: The Pharisees are mistaken in Christ’s Titles. Part II.

154. Even if he were a High Priest, if people see him going from one house to another in disguise, then they say, "there comes a Fool," and many may well say it is the Devil. But it is not all true; the people only give them such a title when they assume such images, shapes, or gestures. Afterward, they become men again when they take off the **mask** <note>original: "Vizard" — a mask or disguise, often used in theater or for trickery.</note>. Many a person goes about this way only so that he may visit his **lover** <note>original: "Paramour"</note> or go somewhere else, making up some foolish excuse for the occasion. But in such matters, people should not believe the title; when people say one wearing a mask is a beast, or Death, or the Devil—no, he is merely a *captive* of the **Devil.**

155. Likewise, people should not believe it when the *Primate* <note>Boehme refers to his accuser, Pastor Gregorius Richter, using the high-ranking title of "Primate" to highlight the gap between the Pastor's status and his behavior.</note> attaches titles to the Shoemaker and calls him **a Heretic, a Sectary, a Fool, a Visionary** <note>original: "Phantastick"</note>, **a Fanatic, an Enthusiast, a Rascally Knave, a forsworn or perjured Shoemaker, and more.** These are such stretched, strained names, like a mask which the Devil puts upon him because the Devil is in a struggle and at odds with him. It is not good to believe these names, even though the High Priest himself says it. Men may be deceived, for even great people may be mistaken. After all, the *Pharisees* were mistaken about **Christ’s titles**; how then will the *Primate* not be mistaken about the Shoemaker's titles, seeing as he knows the Shoemaker is but a **layperson** <note>original: "Laick" — a person who is not a member of the clergy.</note>, and he *does not know* the **Name of Christ** within him?

156. *The "good Lord" <note>Boehme is likely being sarcastic here, referring to Pastor Richter's self-importance.</note>, surely, was once with some shoemaker who had touched the **shoe polish** <note>original: "Blacking"</note>, which made him stink. Because of this, he is so very much angered, offended, and enraged that he assumes THIS Shoemaker always smells of that dye. Therefore, he is fiercely enraged against the Shoemaker’s titles. Likely some shoemaker’s **resin** <note>original: "Pitch" — a sticky substance used in shoemaking.</note> remains stuck to his hands and has dried there, and in that regard, he gives the Shoemaker such abominable names because he is still angry about it. He cannot endure the Shoemaker yet, and is afraid the Shoemaker might defile his own pen; therefore, he forbids the Shoemaker to use it. O, Primate! The Shoemaker has his titles WITHIN himself; you cannot defile them, and he will keep THEM well enough eternally.*
